ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision scoring and telemetry overlay system for Drone Soccer arenas that automatically tracks ball possession and goal entries.
ideas.title: AeroGoal Tracker and Telemetry HUD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Reflects the physical build and live demonstration winning pattern seen in hardware and robotics hackathons like the Rover project, appealing directly to referees and spectators during intense arena matches.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight ESP32-based sensor pod attached to drone exoskeletons that measures crash G-force and instantly signals restart eligibility for tournament marshals.
ideas.title: CageGuard: Impact Telemetry & Crash Detection Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering and solves a real officiating bottleneck for tournament rules regarding restart windows after crashes.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary localized radio communication relay system ensuring zero-latency channel chatter and telemetry backup for drone pilots in steel-reinforced arenas.
ideas.title: OmniMesh: Low-Latency Pilot Communication Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates robust offline hardware engineering, mirroring the approach that won Best Hardware at ICHack.

ideas.pitch: A generative design and simulation tool for rapid 3D-printing and testing of lightweight, impact-absorbing protective exoskeletons for custom drone soccer builds.
ideas.title: ExoShield: Aerodynamic Cage Optimization Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the mandatory physical exoskeleton rule with a practical tool that teams can use to optimize their builds on-site.

ideas.pitch: An automated telemetry log analyzer that processes flight controller black-box data post-match to diagnose motor failures, PID tuning flaws, and battery health.
ideas.title: FlightLogix: Black-Box Flight Controller Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides high utility for competing teams during the tight match turnaround windows, standing out through practical engineering depth.
